purpose: Define deterministic lockable randomization plus portable preset/import/export behavior for player-authored Character appearance without mutating Species/Form biology, hidden state, equipment ownership or renderer truth.

contains: profile-specific authored overrides where scope permits
Species-bounded authored biological palette choices where explicitly editable
authored fields for one declared editable Species/Form/season/transition profile

determinism_rule: Same authorized semantic state, profile, seed, lock set and eligible choice-set/version inputs yield the same proposed semantic randomization result; renderer asset filenames are not randomization identity.
randomization_guards: Only authorized compatible player-authored choices participate.
Current Form, transition occurrence, persistent biological history and hidden markers cannot be randomized.
Equipment ownership/equipped state cannot be randomized.
Presentation wardrobe may randomize only from curated compatible nonmechanical presentation assets.
Unavailable pack content and permission-filtered content are absent from the eligible set.
Randomization is proposal-only until P06-ACT-025 accepts it through P06-MUT-001.

locks.behavior: Locked fields retain current authored value and are excluded from candidate draws.
locks.derived_fields: not lock targets because they are recomputed from authoritative/authored parents
locks.persistence: Locks may be stored with a preset; transient editing locks need not mutate Character appearance.

undo_preview.committed_undo: requires a new authorized P06-MUT-001 write using current expected_version; historical receipts remain immutable

import_rules: Substitution is allowed only when a declared compatibility rule permits it and the exact substitution is shown before authorization.
Source-owned biological fields in imported data are ignored/rejected as nonportable authority, never written into Character truth.
A preset for a different Species/morphology profile reports incompatibilities instead of coercing anatomy.
A renderer-unsupported preset can still be semantically compatible; renderer support is reported separately.
Partially recoverable import exposes the compatible subset, rejected subset and required owner/player review before P06-ACT-028.
export_rules: Export contains only permission-authorized portable authored appearance/presentation data.
Hidden biology and hidden equipment never appear in export or derived metadata.
Export records stable IDs, semantic values, profile scopes, versions, optional seed/locks and provenance class for portable fields.
Export may reference presentation wardrobe IDs but never claims inventory ownership.
Export may state renderer preferences/coverage as nonauthoritative metadata.

species_examples.rule: A full appearance preset may contain four separately authored seasonal profiles; import never changes current season.
Preset stores base and authorized animal authored identities; hybrid is recomputed and not serialized as independent authority.
Post-transition profile data can apply only to a Character whose upstream transition state matches that outcome.
Persistent adaptation history is excluded from preset portability; cosmetics that accommodate visible markers remain portable.
Preferred phenotype preset may contain at most three fur colors plus pattern/texture; live mechanics-owned state is not serialized as cosmetic authority.
Preset stores one constituent identity plus presentation preferences; it does not serialize seventeen independent constituent appearances.
Natural fur and cosmetic dye remain separate channels; only source-bounded authored natural choice and cosmetic dye are portable, not invented biology.
Wardrobe presets require a four-arm-compatible topology variant or explicit unavailable status.
